name: Chaos Thérèse
source:
The main antagonist in the 2nd main quest's episode 3 "French Revolution Story Zone".

Thérèse is the eldest daughter of Marie Antoinette, and sister of Louis XVII.

A giant recolored version of her called "Chaos Thérèse G" appeared in a boss rush event, though it is not part of the storyline.
